title: Azal University for Human Development (AUHD): Institutional Research and Academic Works Index — Issue 01 (725 Bibliographic Records)

authors.name: Rami Alkubati
authors.role: Dataset compiler / creator as registered in existing DataCite metadata

abstract: Issue 01 of the Institutional Research and Academic Works Index associated with Azal University for Human Development (AUHD), Sana'a, Yemen. The collection contains 725 institutionally reviewed bibliographic and academic-work records across multiple academic fields and formats (including journal articles, book chapters, theses and graduation projects). The source CSV preserves 15 columns with 654 DOI URLs, 73 publisher/source URLs and three references to potential open copies. The university representative confirms that the catalog has been reviewed. Author fields remain empty in 724 source records. This record is an institutional bibliographic metadata dataset, not a deposit of the full text of the 725 referenced works. The existing dataset was first published in Harvard Dataverse on 11 November 2026.

copyright_note: The dataset metadata is separate from the copyright-protected publications that it cites. The licence does not authorize replication of underlying publishers' PDFs or book chapters.
